# telnyx_bulk_sim_card_action (Data Source)

A bulk action on SIM cards, such as setting public IPs, with its progress.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `action_type` (String) The action type. It can be one of the following: <br/> <ul> <li><code>bulk_disable_voice</code> - disable voice for every SIM Card in a SIM Card Group.</li> <li><code>bulk_enable_voice</code> - enable voice for every SIM Card in a SIM Card Group.</li> <li><code>bulk_set_public_ips</code> - set a public IP for each specified SIM Card.</li> </ul>
- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date-time indicating when the resource was created.
- `record_type` (String)
- `settings` (String) A JSON object representation of the bulk action payload. A JSON document; use `jsondecode()` to read it.
- `sim_card_actions_summary` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sim_card_actions_summary))
- `updated_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date-time indicating when the resource was updated.

Read-Only:

- `status` (String)
